description: Establishment of  a Faculty of Health Sciences - Eastern University, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.277 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
